JNJ.headline: First Therapy for Advanced Head & Neck Cancer in 10 Years: Johnson & Johnson Secures Accelerated FDA Nod
JNJ.summary: Johnson & Johnson wins FDA accelerated approval for RYBREVANT FASPRO to treat recurrent or metastatic head and neck cancer.

JNJ.headline: Reported Earlier, FDA Grants J&J Accelerated Approval For Rybrevant Faspro In Advanced Head And Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma, Based On OrigAMI-4 Phase 1b/2 Trial Showing 42% Overall Response Rate
FDA Grants Accelerated Approval for RYBREVANT FASPRO in Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
JNJ.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has granted accelerated approval for RYBREVANT FASPRO as a single agent for the treatment of adults with recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

JNJ.headline: FDA Grants Accelerated Approval To Rybrevant Faspro For Recurrent Or Metastatic Head And Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
Johnson & Johnson Receives NMPA Approval for Macitentan Dispersible Tablets
JNJ.summary: China's National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) has approved Johnson & Johnson's macitentan dispersible tablets for the treatment of pediatric pulmonary arterial hypertension.

JNJ.headline: Oxford BioDynamics Announces Commercial Agreement with Johnson & Johnson
JNJ.summary: Oxford BioDynamics (OBD) has entered into a commercial agreement with Johnson & Johnson for the use of its EpiSwitch® Orion platform.

Jim Cramer Likes This Industrial Stock: ‘It’s Come Down A Great Deal’
JNJ.summary: Cramer recommends Howmet and J&J, prefers Micron over Western Digital, criticizes Nebius, and favors Lam Research over KLA.

JNJ.headline: Growth And Cyclical Sectors Lead Monday Trading
JNJ.summary: Seven sectors are higher and four are lower in Monday’s regular session, with growth and cyclical sectors splitting the top of the table. The leaders are separated rather than clustered, with no single gap clearly standing apart from the other breaks across the table.

JNJ.headline: Reported Sunday, Johnson & Johnson Says Impella Outcomes Depend On Patient Selection, Timing And Post-Procedural Care, Citing Lower Mortality In Three TCT Analyses Versus CHIP-BCIS3; PROTECT IV Results Expected 2027
Johnson & Johnson Reports Positive Clinical Outcomes for Impella Heart Pumps in HRPCI
JNJ.summary: Johnson & Johnson presented data from three clinical analyses at the 2026 Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics symposium demonstrating positive survival and patient outcomes for Impella heart pumps.

JNJ.headline: Johnson & Johnson Reports Positive Clinical Trial Results for Shockwave Javelin Catheter
JNJ.summary: Johnson & Johnson presented positive 30-day results from the FORWARD CAD clinical trial of its investigational Shockwave Javelin catheter at the 2026 Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics conference.
